name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
What's new since v3.39.2

🔗 Links to capacity and releases (3.44.0) — “Share” on the Capacity tab now puts the tab's sprint and the person or role picked on the right into the link, and the recipient lands on the same selection with it highlighted (all of a person's rows, or the role's group). Planned releases and release-history records got a “Copy link” button for everyone who can see releases; the toast names what was copied, and the highlight waits for the screen to finish loading. Also fixed: the address bar lost the Capacity and Releases sections on startup. Links need YouTrack 2026.1+, like “Share” itself.

🔎 Filters for the sprint's task tables (3.43.0) — an Assignee · State · Role · Priority row above the “Total resource allocation” tables and the “Assignee distribution” task table: multi-select, a “Tasks shown: N of M” counter, a “filter: N of M” chip on role rows (resource, allocation and over-limit still count the whole composition), and roles left out by the Role filter are hidden entirely; the selection is shared by both screens and lives until the page is reloaded. Also new: sort by “State” in role tables; “Type” and other fields that are never columns can now be picked as display fields; the reminders bell recounts right after your own save, without a reload; “Clear draft” shows after the first edit.

🧭 Rail toolbar (3.42.0) — the reminders bell moved to the rail header next to “collapse”; the service buttons (clear draft, settings, user guide, feedback, language) became a row of JetBrains icons with Ring UI tooltips (500 ms, also on keyboard focus); the carets of navigation groups moved into the left margin so group and item icons line up.

🗂 Reminders journal (3.41.0) — the bell now opens the dialog with two tabs, “Active” and “Journal”: the last 50 records of the project — when an item fired, the module, the entity, how and by whom it went out (“active · N d.” while it is still on). Any addressee can delete a record; deleting does not resolve an active reminder. Also fixed: the journal was never written in 3.40.0 (YouTrack runs GET endpoints read-only) — the sync moved to a POST.

🔔 Reminders in the planner (3.40.0) — when a project opens, a dialog lists what needs attention right now: sprint roles not finished on the end date (and sprints that ended with no role agreed), capacity not approved before the start and after, releases past their planned date — one “Go to” button per item takes you to the place. A bell with a counter in the header opens the same list any time. Show it once a day per person and project, or on every open; addressees are computed on the server (validators, capacity approvers, release manager and engineer). Off by default after the upgrade — enable it in the new “Notifications” settings section.

⚠️ Data schema changed 3.39.2 → 3.40.0 — 3.40.0 added a project property for the reminders journal and six reminders* settings keys (rolling back below 3.40.0 leaves the journal as a harmless orphan and strips those keys on read). Anything deeper requires a YouTrack database backup taken before the update.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Planner settings for the project: functional roles and issue fields, permission groups (validation / editing / assignee assignment / history clearing), planning modes. Sprint planning itself lives in the main-menu item «Smart Sprint Planner».

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint planning from YouTrack's main menu: pick an accessible project where the planner is set up, plan sprint composition by role, allocate tasks, review history. Permissions and settings are checked against the selected project. Includes a «Backlog» module for triaging and laying pool tasks into roles/sprint.
